title: 1.25 Million Dollar Lake Home in Belton, Texas
description: Come take a tour of this breathtaking 1.25 million dollar Belton lake property. It is rare to find a house that is immaculate and completely updated with high-end appliances and conveniences. With three outdoor entertainment areas, views of the lake, lake access for kayaking or fishing, a fire pit, and a hot tub, expect to be everyone’s favorite place to be. In the mornings, grab a cup of coffee from the upstairs wet bar and step outside to watch the stunning sunrises from the upstairs covered patio. Enjoy views of Lake Belton from almost every room in the house. 🏖️ #belton #texas
